γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)

γούνατ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα)

δέος: δέος — fear; also, of the thing feared, danger; neut. nom./acc. sg.
δέρμα: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. acc. sg.
δίκη: δίκη — custom, right, the way things are done; fem. nom. sg.

διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)

δρυὸς: δρῦς — oak; fem. gen. sg.: ’of an oak’
δυοκαίδεκα: δυοκαίδεκα — twelve; numeral, indeclinable (= Attic δώδεκα)
δυσμενέες: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; used substantivally, ’enemies’; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσμενεῖς)
δόσαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
δόσις: δόσις — giving, a gift; fem. nom. sg.
δώῃ: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic δῷ), after αἴ κε: ’may grant’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῆμόν: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic)
δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. acc. sg., epithet of heroes
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)

εὐνὰς: εὐνή — bed, lair, resting-place; fem. acc. pl.
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.

θήρεσσιν: θήρ — wild beast; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic θηρσί)

θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελέων ἐξείλετο θυμόν ’took the life out of the limbs’)

κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic

κείνου: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. gen. sg.

κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κρίνας: κρίνω — pick out, choose, judge; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out’
κρατερὸν: κρατερός — strong, mighty (by-form of καρτερός); masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος as subject

λάεσσι: λᾶας — stone; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic λίθοις)
λαέρταο: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
λευκὰ: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. pl.
ληΐδα: ληΐς — booty, spoil; fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic λεία)
λυγρὸν: λυγρός — baneful, bitter, grievous; masc. acc. sg.

μάλιστ: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα, elided (μάλιστ’ = μάλιστα): ’most of all, especially’

μάχοιτο: μάχομαι — fight; pres. opt. 3 sg., + dat.: ’should fight against’

μέλαν: μέλας — black, dark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μεγάλη: μέγας — great, large; fem. nom. sg.

οἴω: οἶος — alone; masc. nom. dual: ’we two alone’

οἶκόνδε: οἶκος — house, home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’homeward’

οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)

πάθεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπαθεν)

πλησίον: πλησίος — near, neighbouring; neut. acc. sg. as adv. πλησίον: ’near, beside’
ποίει: ποιέω — make; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐποίει)
ποθ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided before a rough breathing (ποθ’ = ποτέ)

προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.

πόλινδε: πόλις — city; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’to the city’

πώεα: πῶυ — flock (of sheep); neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted

σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
σίτου: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg.
σιάλους: σίαλος — fat hog, fattened pig; masc. acc. pl.
σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
σφι: σφι — epic dat. pl. pron. ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σχέτλια: σχέτλιος — cruel, dreadful, monstrous; neut. acc. pl.

τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τέσσαρες: τέσσαρες — four; numeral, masc. nom. pl. (Attic τέτταρες)
τέταρτον: τέταρτος — fourth; ordinal numeral, neut. nom./acc. sg.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’
τιμῆς: τιμή — honour, worth; fem. gen. sg.
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοσσοῦτον: τοσοῦτος — so great, so much; epic τοσσοῦτος, neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so far’
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: masc./neut. dat. pl. ’in which, with which’ (τετυγμένα, τοῖς ἐνάμελγεν ’well-made, in which he milked’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: ’the’ (ἰχθύσι τοῖς ὀλίγοισι ’for the little fishes’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’)
τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same syncretic form): ’three’ (ἑταίρους τρεῖς ’three companions’, acc.)
τρηχεῖαν: τρηχύς — rugged, rough; adj., fem. acc. sg.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τόσα: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative demonstrative adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’so much’
τόσσα: τόσος — so much, so many; epic τόσσος (doubled σ), neut. acc. pl.
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’dear one!’
φθινύθουσιν: φθινύθω — waste, consume, cause to waste away (epic lengthened form of φθίνω); pres. 3 pl. transitive: ’waste, consume’
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φυλάσσω: φυλάσσω — keep watch, guard; pres. subj. 1 sg., + acc. of duration: ’keep watch through (the night)’
φωτῶν: φώς — man, mortal; masc. gen. pl.
φῦλον: φῦλον — tribe, race, kind; neut. acc. sg.
χαμαιευνάδες: χαμαιευνάς — sleeping on the ground (χαμαί + εὐνή ’bed’); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with σύες
χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’he rejoiced’ (χαῖρε φήμῃ ’rejoiced at the omen-word’) · also the imperative at parting: ’farewell’ · also with a dative of cause, ’be glad’ (χαῖρε … φιλότητι ’be glad in love’)
χώρῳ: χῶρος — place, spot; masc. dat. sg.
χῶρον: χῶρος — place, spot, region; masc. acc. sg.
ἀέξεται: ἀέξω — increase, cause to grow; mid.-pass. ἀέξομαι, pres. 3 sg.: ’grows’
ἀέξῃ: ἀέξω — make grow, rear, increase; pres. subj. 3 sg. (after αἴ κεν)
ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl.
ἀλλοτρίης: ἀλλότριος — of another, foreign, strange; fem. gen. sg.
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’) · also with ὀστεόφιν, ’around’ (ἀμφ’ ὀστεόφιν θὶς ’a heap around the bones’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀν: ἀνά (elided ἀν’) — up, along; prep. + acc.: ἀν’ ἰθύν ’in a straight line’ · also + acc., ’throughout, up and down’ (ἀν’ Ἑλλάδα ’throughout Hellas’)
ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
ἀνάρσιοι: ἀνάρσιος — hostile, unfriendly; masc. nom. pl.
ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv.
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’) · also + dat., ’on, upon’ (ἀνὰ φαιδίμῳ ὤμῳ ’on the shining shoulder’)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀποιχομένοιο: ἀποίχομαι — be gone away, be departed; pres. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχεύων: ἀχεύω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic by-form of ἀχέω
ἁπάντων: ἅπας — all, the whole of; neut. gen. pl.: ’of all (ills)’ · also masc. gen. pl., in comparison: ’of all (mortals)’ · also gen. pl. with a noun: ’of all (men)’
ἄκριας: ἄκρις — hilltop, peak, height; fem. acc. pl.
ἄλγος: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom. sg.
ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλοισιν: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. pl.
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλυδις: ἄλλυδις — in one direction, elsewhere; adv. (ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’each a different way’)
ἄλφιτα: ἄλφιτον — barley-groats, barley-meal (usu. pl.); neut. acc. pl.
ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’best’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’best’ (λαὸν ἄριστον ’the best host’)
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἄρσενες: ἄρσην — male; masc. nom. pl. (= Attic ἄρρενες)
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
ἐδωδῆς: ἐδωδή — food, eating; fem. gen. sg.
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐθέλουσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 3 pl.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — here, to this place; adv., with -δε suffix of direction (’in this place’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐοικότες: ἔοικα — be like, be fitting, resemble; perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’fitting’ (μῦθοι ἐοικότες ’fitting words’) · also + dat., ’like, resembling’ (ἄνδρεσσιν ἐοικότες ’like men’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλοὶ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. pl.
ἐσσὶ: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic ἐσσί (= Attic εἶ)
ἐστόρεσεν: στόρνυμι — spread, spread smooth; aor. 3 sg.: ’spread smooth, calmed’ (of the sea)
ἐσχατιῇ: ἐσχατιή — the furthest point, edge, border; dat. sg.
ἐφίλει: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was fond of, cherished’
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize, grasp; aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg. (ἑλών): ’having seized’
ἑοῖς: ἑός — his own, her own (by-form of the possessive ὅς); masc./neut. dat. pl.
ἓν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔβαν: βαίνω — go, walk; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔβησαν)
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη)
ἔδησαν: δέω — bind, make fast; aor. 3 pl.
ἔδμεναι: ἔδω — eat; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐσθίειν): ’to eat’
ἔδοντες: ἔδω — eat (epic, = Attic ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’eating’
ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
ἔθνεα: ἔθνος — tribe, throng, host; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔθνη)
ἔθρεψε: τρέφω — rear, nurture, bring up; aor. 3 sg.
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’) · also prep. + gen. with a particle between it and its noun: ἔκ γε γυναικός ’at the hands of a woman’
ἔκλυον: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 1 sg. · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they heard’ (οἱ δ’ ἔκλυον ’they heard’)
ἔλασσε: ἐλαύνω — drive; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἤλασε); τεῖχος ἔλασσε ’drove (a wall), i.e. built’
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι)
ἔλυσε: λύω — loose, undo, untie; aor. 3 sg.; with ἀπό in tmesis (ἀπὸ … ἔλυσε = ἀπέλυσε) ’loosed off’
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔνεικε: φέρω (suppletive aor. stem ἐνεκ-) — bring, carry; aor. 3 sg.; whether this form has lost an augment is uncertain: ’brought’
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν · also ’on the one side’ (ἔνθεν μὲν γὰρ πέτραι ’on one side are rocks’)
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’) · also = ἔπεστι, accented on the first syllable when it stands for the verb: ’there is (upon)’ · also as preverb in tmesis, placed after its object: ἔπι … ὦρσεν = ἐπῶρσεν ’stirred up (against)’
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα)
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition/predicative, naming a maker: ἔργον Ἡφαίστοιο ’the work of Hephaestus’
ἔρχατο: εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut in, pen; plpf. pass. 3 pl., epic -ατο ending (Attic uses a periphrasis, εἰργμένοι ἦσαν): ’were penned’
ἔστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔστ’ = ἔστι)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκηλοι: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. pl.
ἕπεο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., loosely: ’come along, follow’
ἠελίοιο: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic Ἡλίου)
ἠπείροιο: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἠπείρῳ: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land, shore; fem. dat. sg.
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’)
ἡγήσατο: ἡγέομαι — lead the way, go before; aor. 3 sg.
ἡμετέρη: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; fem. nom. sg.
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἥμενον: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., epic ἥμενος: ’sitting’
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.) · also relative + indefinite, in the compound ἥν τινα = ἥτις (fem.): ’whatever, what’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἧμαι: ἧμαι — sit, sit still, remain; pres. 1 sg. mid.
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl. (hortatory): ’let us go’ · also subj. in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’we go, are going’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … ἀγροὺς ἴομεν ’while we go through the fields’)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ἷζεν: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 sg.
ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀδυρόμενος: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀλέσθαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. mid. inf.
ὀλίγη: ὀλίγος — little, small; fem. nom. sg.
ὀνόμαζεν: ὀνομάζω — call by name, name; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ὠνόμαζε); with ἐκ in tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζεν) ’called by name’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’)
ὁππόθεν: ὁππόθεν — from where; epic indirect interrog. adv. (= Attic πόθεν)
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄπασσεν: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, give; aor. 3 sg.: ’gave’
ὄρχαμος: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader; masc. nom. sg. (ὄρχαμος ἀνδρῶν ’chief of men’)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅσσαι: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much as, as many as; fem. nom. pl., epic geminated form ὅσσαι (= ὅσαι)
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’ · also in ὡς ὅτ’, ’as when (a minstrel does)’, the verb left unexpressed · also in ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ introducing a simile with a finite verb expressed: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ … ἁλιεὺς … προΐησι)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’) · also in an indirect question, ’what’ (ὅττι ἑ κήδοι ’what was troubling him’)
ὑπέδεκτο: ὑποδέχομαι — undertake, promise, agree to; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented
ὑπέρβιον: ὑπέρβιος — overweening, excessive; fem./neut. acc. sg.
ὑπερφιάλοισιν: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὑψηλὴ: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. nom. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for which, to which’ (referring back to the ship, νηῦς) · also ’on which’, of a road: τὴν ὁδὸν ᾗ δὴ ’the journey on which’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀλόχῳ (ᾗ … ἀλόχῳ ’his own wife’)
ᾤχοντ: οἴχομαι — be gone, go; impf. 3 pl., elided (ᾤχοντ’ = ᾤχοντο): ’they were gone’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥυτοῖσιν: ῥυτός — drawn, hauled; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), of stones
